name: GENAI_INVOICE_VALIDATOR
description: Invoice validator from process flow + api/from scripts +app

apps.title: Warranty claims - invoice validator
apps.description: Demo: warranty claims list and claim detail with AI invoice validation (GENAI_INVOICE_VALIDATOR).

dictionary.name: genai_invoice_result
dictionary.description: One row per invoice extraction request, written by the Table Interaction nodes of genai_invoice_extraction_flow_withoutAgentNode and read by the app via requestId.

dictionary.name: genai_claim
dictionary.description: Demo warranty claims shown in the invoice validator app. The claim context is sent to the invoice extraction agents.

dictionary.name: genai_invoice_request
dictionary.description: Server-side state of an invoice validation: written by /prepare, consumed once by /extract. The prompt is always built server-side from this row and the claim, never taken from the client.

jsclass.name: uploadAttachment
jsclass.description: API POST /attachments: validates and stores an invoice file for a claim.

jsclass.name: prepareInvoice
jsclass.description: API POST /prepare: reads a stored attachment, detects image / text PDF / scanned PDF, extracts PDF text and stores the request server-side. Never returns a prompt.

jsclass.name: getClaims
jsclass.description: API GET /claims: list of demo claims with their latest validation; with ?claimNo=X returns that claim plus its full validation history. Only validations of existing attachments count.

jsclass.name: getAttachmentValidations
jsclass.description: API GET /attachments/validations?id=: validation history of one attachment, newest first.

jsclass.name: deleteAttachment
jsclass.description: API DELETE /attachments?id=: deletes an attachment and its validations (uploader only).

jsclass.name: getAttachmentFile
jsclass.description: API GET /attachments/file?id=: returns one attachment's file as a data URI (preview/download).

jsclass.name: listAttachments
jsclass.description: API GET /attachments?claimNo=: the claim's attachments (no file contents) with their latest validation.

jsclass.name: seedClaimDemoData
jsclass.description: Creates or refreshes the demo claims in genai_claim (safe to run repeatedly).

jsclass.name: getAttachmentContent
jsclass.description: API GET /attachmentContent?id=: streams one attachment as its real file type (for sap.m.PDFViewer / sap.m.Image source URLs).

jsclass.name: extractInvoice
jsclass.description: API POST /extract: consumes a prepared request (owner + status checked), reads the stored attachment, builds the agent prompt server-side with a prompt-injection guard, calls the image / text / PDF agent, validates and saves the result.
